quote:
Margi has an exceptional gift for translating a vision into living, breathing spaces that feel both intentional and wholly natural. Working collaboratively — with my husband on the hardscaping and with me on the planting design — she crafted a lush sub-tropical native garden across our front yard and pool area that is nothing short of breathtaking.
The result is a seamless harmony of structure and nature; one that draws the eye, stirs the senses, and invites you to slow down. Neighbours and friends regularly stop to admire it, and the response has been overwhelming. Beyond the aesthetic, it has genuinely added value to our home — but what means most is that it feels deeply, authentically ours.
There is something quietly profound about a garden done well. Tending to it has become one of life’s simple pleasures. If you’re looking for someone who understands not just design, but the soul of a garden, Margi is truly remarkable.
author: Jaclyn Beer
